title: Matterbridge KNX plugin
description: matterbridge-ai-factory-knx-bus-domotique-europ-en-via-passerelle-ip v. 1.0.0 - Expose KNX (European home-automation bus via IP gateway) devices defined in a CSV to Matter.

connection.title: KNX/IP gateway connection
connection.description: How to reach the KNX bus through your IP interface/router.

type.title: Connection type
type.description: tunneling (point-to-point with the interface) or routing (multicast).

host.title: Gateway IP
host.description: IP of the KNX/IP interface or router (e.g. 192.168.1.50). For routing use 224.0.23.12.

local_ip.title: Local IP (optional)
local_ip.description: Local interface IP to bind to (useful with multiple network cards).

tunneling_secure.title: KNX IP Secure tunneling
tunneling_secure.description: Enable KNX/IP Secure tunneling (TCP). Leave off for plain tunneling.

device_password.title: Device/tunnel password
device_password.description: Tunnel user password for KNX IP Secure (only when secure tunneling is enabled).

devices_csv.title: Devices CSV path
devices_csv.description: Absolute path to the CSV file listing your KNX devices and group addresses (ETS export).

poll_interval_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: How often to send GroupValue_Read to refresh state. 0 disables polling.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices (by name) in the list will be exposed. Empty list = expose all.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices (by name) in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging.
